G2730.def:
**κατ-οικέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX very frequently and nearly always for יָשַׁב ;]
1. trans., **to inhabit, dwell in**: with accusative, [[Luk.13.4|Luk.13:4]], [[Act.1.10; 2.9, 14; 4.16; 9.32, 35; 19.10|Act.1:10 2:9, 14 4:16 9:32, 35 19:10]], 17. [[Rev.17.2|Rev.17:2]]; of God, [[Mat.23.21|Mat.23:21]]
2. Intrans., **to settle, dwell**: [[Act.22.12|Act.22:12]] before ἐν (cl.), [[Act.1.20|Act.1:20]] (LXX) [[Act.2.5; 7.2, 4; 7.48; 9.22; 11.29; 13.27; 17.24|Act.2:5 7:2, 4 7:48 9:22 11:29 13:27 17:24]], [[Heb.11.9|Heb.11:9]], [[Rev.13.12|Rev.13:12]]; before εἰς (B1., § 39, 3; M, _Pr._, 62 f., 234 f.), [[Mat.2.23; 4.13|Mat.2:23 4:13]], [[Act.7.4|Act.7:4]]; ἐπὶ τ. γῆς ([[Num.13.33|Num.13:33]], al.), [[Rev.3.10; 6.10; 8.13; 11.10; 13.8, 14; 17.8|Rev.3:10 6:10 8:13 11:10 13:8, 14 17:8]]; ἐπὶ παντὸς προσώπου τ. γ., [[Act.17.26|Act.17:26]] ὅπου, [[Rev.2.13|Rev.2:13]] ἐκεῖ (of demons), [[Mat.12.45|Mat.12:45]], [[Luk.11.26|Luk.11:26]]. Metaphorical, of divine indwelling: ὁ Χριστός, [[Eph.3.17|Eph.3:17]] τ. πνεῦμα, [[Jas.4.5|Jas.4:5]] (κατῴκισεν, T, WH, R, txt.); τ. πλήωρμα (τ. θεότητος), [[Col.1.19; 2.9|Col.1:19 2:9]]; δικαιοσύνη (cf. [[Wis.1.4|Wis.1:4]]), [[2Pe.3.13|2Pe.3:13]] (cf. ἐν-κατοικέω).†
κατοικίζω,
[in LXX for יָשַׁב hi., etc. ;]
**to cause to dwell**: metaphorically, with accusative, τὸ πνεῦμα, [[Jas.4.5|Jas.4:5]] (Rec., R, mg., κατῴκησεν).†
(AS)

G2749.def:
**κεῖμαι **
[in LXX: [[Jer.24.1|Jer.24:1]] (יָעַד hoph,), al. ;]
used as passive of τίθημι (LS, see word), to be laid, to lie;
(a) **of persons**: an infant, [[Luk.2.12, 16|Luk.2:12, 16]]; a dead body, [[Mat.28.6|Mat.28:6]], [[Luk.23.53|Luk.23:53]], [[Jhn.20.12|Jhn.20:12]];
(b) **of things, to lie, be laid or set, stand**: [[Mat.5.14|Mat.5:14]], [[Jhn.2.6; 19.29; 20.5-7; 21.9|Jhn.2:6 19:29 20:5-7 21:9]], [[Rev.4.2; 21.16|Rev.4:2 21:16]]; trop., Θεμέλιος, [[1Co.3.11|1Co.3:11]] before prep. with accusative, πρός, [[Mat.3.10|Mat.3:10]], [[Luk.3.9|Luk.3:9]]; εἰς, [[Luk.12.19|Luk.12:19]] ἐπί, trop., κάλυμμα, [[2Co.3.15|2Co.3:15]] Metaphorical, ὁ κόσμος ἐν τ. πονηριῷ κ., [[1Jn.5.19|1Jn.5:19]] to be laid down, **appointed**: of law, with dative of person(s), [[1Ti.1.9|1Ti.1:9]] before εἰς with accusative (of purpose), [[Luk.2.34|Luk.2:34]], [[Php.1.16|Php.1:16]], [[1Th.3.3|1Th.3:3]]
(cf. ἀνά-, συν-ανά-, ἀντί-, ἀπό-, ἐπί-, κατά-, παρά-, περί-, πρό-κειμαι).†
(AS)

G2736.def:
**κάτω **
_adv._ (κατά), [in LXX for מַטָּה, תַּחַת and cogn. forms ;]
1. down, downwards (with verbs of motion), [[Mat.4.6|Mat.4:6]], [[Luk.4.9|Luk.4:9]], [[Jhn.8.6|Jhn.8:6]], 8, [[Act.20.9|Act.20:9]].
2. **below, beneath**: [[Mrk.14.66|Mrk.14:66]], [[Act.2.19|Act.2:19]]" (LXX) ; ἕως κ. ([[Ezk.1.27|Eze.1:27]], al.), [[Mat.27.51|Mat.27:51]], [[Mrk.15.38|Mrk.15:38]]. τὰ κ. (opposite to τ. ἄνω), [[Jhn.8.23|Jhn.8:23]] Compar. κατωτέρω: ἀπὸ διετοῦς καὶ κ. (cf. [[1Ch.27.21|1Ch.27:21]]), [[Mat.2.16|Mat.2:16]].†
(AS)

G2762.def:
**κεραία** (WH, κερέα, see _App._, 151), -ας, ἠ
(κέρας),
**a little horn**: of the point or extremity which distinguishes some _Heb._ letters from others (e.g. ד from ר; _DCG_, ii, 733), [[Mat.5.18|Mat.5:18]], [[Luk.16.17|Luk.16:17]].†
(AS)

G2776.def:
**κεφαλή**, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX nearly always for רֹאשׁ ;]
**the head**: [[Mat.5.35|Mat.5:35]], [[Mrk.6.24|Mrk.6:24]], [[Rev.1.14; 9.7|Rev.1:14 9:7]], al. mult.; figuratively, ἄνθρακες ἐπὶ τὴν κ., [[Rom.12.20|Rom.12:20]] (LXX); αἷμι, [[Act.18.6|Act.18:6]] metaphorically, of a husband, with genitive, [[1Co.1.13|1Co.1:13]], [[Eph.5.23|Eph.5:23]]; of Christ, [[1Co.11.3|1Co.11:3]], [[Eph.4.15; 5.23|Eph.4:15 5:23]], [[Col.1.18; 2.10, 19|Col.1:18 2:10, 19]]; of things, κ. γωνίας, [[Mat.21.42|Mat.21:42]] (LXX)
(AS)

G2753.def:
**κελεύω **
[in LXX: I [[Est.9.53|Est.9:53]], [[Tob.8.18|Tob.8:18]], al., and frequently in 1-4Mac ;]
**to urge on, bid by word of mouth, order, command **(mostly of one in authority): with accusative and inf. aor., [[Mat.14.19, 28; 18.25; 27.64|Mat.14:19, 28 18:25 27:64]], [[Luk.18.40|Luk.18:40]], [[Act.4.15; 5.34; 8.38; 22.30; 23.10; 25.6, 17|Act.4:15 5:34 8:38 22:30 23:10 25:6, 17]]; with ellipse of accusative, [[Mat.8.18; 14.9; 27.58|Mat.8:18 14:9 27:58]], [[Act.12.19; 21.33|Act.12:19 21:33]]; with accusative and inf. Pres., [[Act.21.34; 22.24; 23.3, 35; 25.21; 27.43|Act.21:34 22:24 23:3, 35 25:21 27:43]]; with ellipse of accusative, [[Act.16.22|Act.16:22]] ptcp. aor., [[Act.25.23|Act.25:23]]†
_SYN._: see: ἐντέλλω (AS)

G2723.def:
**κατηγορέω**, -ῶ
(κατά, ἀγορεύω), [in LXX: Dan LXX 6:5, (9), [[1Ma.7.6|1Ma.7:6]] [[1Mac.7.25|1Mac 7:25]], [[2Ma.4.47|2Ma.4:47]] [[2Mac.10.13|2Mac 10:13]] [[2Mac.10.21|2Mac 10:21]], [[4Ma.9.14|4Ma.9:14]] * ;]
**to make accusation, accuse, **
(a) **in general**: absol., [[Rom.2.15|Rom.2:15]] with genitive of person(s) (cl., WM, 254), [[Jhn.5.45|Jhn.5:45]] irreg. with accusative of person(s), [[Rev.12.10|Rev.12:10]]
(b) **before a judge**: absol., [[Act.24.2, 19|Act.24:2, 19]]; with genitive of person(s), [[Mat.12.10|Mat.12:10]], [[Mrk.3.2|Mrk.3:2]], [[Luk.6.7; 11.54|Luk.6:7 11:54]] (WH, txt., R, om.), [[Luk.23.2, 10|Luk.23:2, 10]], [[Jhn.8.6|Jhn.8:6]] [[Act.25.5; 28.19|Act.25:5 28:19]]; id. with accusative of thing(s) (cl., but see WM, l.with), [[Mrk.15.3-4;|Mrk.15:3-4]] with genitive of thing(s) (Dem.), [[Act.24.8; 25.11|Act.24:8 25:11]]; before περί, with genitive of thing(s) (Thuc., viii, 85), [[Act.24.13|Act.24:13]] with accusative of thing(s), before κατά with genitive of person(s) (WM, § 28, 1), [[Luk.23.14|Luk.23:14]] Pass. (B1., § 54, 3), before ὑπό with genitive, [[Mat.27.12|Mat.27:12]], [[Act.22.30|Act.22:30]]; ὁ κατηγορούμενος, [[Act.25.16|Act.25:16]]†
(AS)

G2785.def:
**κῆτος**, -εος (-ους), τό
[in LXX: [[Jon.2.1|Jon.2.1]] [[Jon.2.10|Jon.2.10]] (דָּג) [[Gen.1.21|Gen.1:21]] (תַּנִּין), etc. ;]
**a huge fish, sea-monster**: [[Mat.12.40|Mat.12:40]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G2782.def:
**κήρυγμα**, -τος, τό
(κηρύσσω), [in LXX: [[2Ch.30.5|2Ch.30:5]] (קוֹל), [[Jon.3.2|Jon.3.2]] (קְרִיאָה), [[Pro.9.3|Pro.9:3]], I [[Est.9.3|Est.9:3]] * ;]
in cl.,
that which is cried by a herald, a proclamation. In NT (see Lft., _Notes_, 161), of God's heralds, **proclamation, message, preaching **(i.e. the substance as distinct from the act which would be expressed by † κήρυξις): [[Mat.12.41|Mat.12:41]], [[Luk.11.32|Luk.11:32]], [[1Co.1.21|1Co.1:21]], [[2Ti.4.17|2Ti.4:17]], [[Tit.1.3|Tit.1:3]]; with genitive cubic., τὸ κ. μου, [[1Co.2.4|1Co.2:4]] ἡμῶν, [[1Co.15.14|1Co.15:14]] with genitive obj., Ἰησοῦ Χρ., [[Rom.16.25|Rom.16:25]]†
(AS)

G2719.def:
**κατ-εσθίω**
("perfective" comp. of ἐσθίω, which see, and cf. M, _Pr._, 111) [in LXX chiefly for אָכַל ;]
**to eat up, devour**: with accusative, of seed, [[Mat.13.4|Mat.13:4]], [[Mrk.4.4|Mrk.4:4]], [[Luk.8.5|Luk.8:5]]; τέκνον, [[Rev.12.4|Rev.12:4]] βιβλαρίδιον, [[Rev.10.9-10;|Rev.10:9-10]] metaphorically, οἰκίας, [[Mat.23.13|Mat.23:13]], [[Mrk.12.40|Mrk.12:40]], [[Luk.20.47|Luk.20:47]]; τ. βίον, [[Luk.15.30|Luk.15:30]] with accusative of person(s), [[Jhn.2.17|Jhn.2:17]] (LXX), [[2Co.11.20|2Co.11:20]], [[Gal.5.15|Gal.5:15]], [[Rev.11.5; 20.9|Rev.11:5 20:9]].†
(AS)

G2739.def:
**καυματίζω**
(καῦμα),
**to burn or scorch up**: with accusative before ἐν πυρί, [[Rev.16.8|Rev.16:8]] Pass., [[Mat.13.14|Mat.13:14]], [[Mrk.4.6|Mrk.4:6]]; before καῦμα μέγα, [[Rev.16.9|Rev.16:9]]†
(AS)

G2798.def:
**κλάδος**, -ου, ὁ
(κλάω), [in LXX for דָּלִיָּה, כַּף, etc. ;]
**a young tender shoot broken off for grafting; then, a branch**: [[Mat.13.32; 21.8; 24.32|Mat.13:32 21:8 24:32]], [[Mrk.4.32; 13.28|Mrk.4:32 13:28]], [[Luk.13.19|Luk.13:19]]; metaphorically, of descendants (cf. [[Sir.40.15|Sir.40:15]]), [[Rom.11.16-19, 21|Rom.11:16-19, 21]].†
(AS)

G2729.def:
**κατ-ισχύω **
[in LXX chiefly for חָזַק ;]
**to overpower, prevail against, prevail**: absol., [[Luk.23.23|Luk.23:23]] with inf., [[Luk.21.36|Luk.21:36]] with genitive, [[Mat.16.18|Mat.16:18]]†
(AS)

G2770.def:
**κερδαίνω **
[in Sm.: [[Job.22.3|Job.22:3]] * ;]
**to gain**: with accusative, [[Mat.25.16-17, 20; 25.22|Mat.25:16-17, 20 25:22]]; τ. κόσμον, [[Mat.16.26|Mat.16:26]], [[Mrk.8.36|Mrk.8:36]], [[Luk.9.25|Luk.9:25]]; absol., **to make profit, get gain**: [[Jas.4.13|Jas.4:13]] Metaphorical, with accusative of thing(s), **to save oneself from, avoid**: [[Act.27.21|Act.27:21]] (Field, _Notes_, 145); with accusative of person(s), **to gain, win**: [[Mat.18.15|Mat.18:15]], [[1Co.9.19-22|1Co.9:19-22]], [[Php.3.8|Php.3:8]]; pass., [[1Pe.3.1|1Pe.3:1]]†
(AS)

G2778.def:
**κῆνσος**, -ου, ὁ (Lat. census),
**a poll-tax**: [[Mat.17.25; 22.17|Mat.17:25 22:17]], [[Mrk.12.14|Mrk.12:14]] (WH, mg., ἐπικεφάλαιον); τ. νόμισμα τοῦ κ., [[Mat.22.19|Mat.22:19]] (see MM, _Exp._, xv).†
(AS)

G2742.def:
**καύσων**, -ωνος, ὁ
(καίω), [in LXX: [[Gen.31.40|Gen.31:40]] א (חֹרֶב), [[Isa.49.10|Isa.49:10]] (שָׁרָב), [[Job.27.21|Job.27:21]], [[Hos.12.1|Hos.12:1]], (2), [[Hos.13.15|Hos.13:15]], [[Jon.4.8|Jon.4.8]], [[Jer.18.17|Jer.18:17]], [[Ezk.17.10; 19.12|Eze.17:10 19:12]] (קָדִים); [[Jer.51.1|Jer.51:1]], From Theodotion [[Dan.3.67|Dan.3:67]]) [[Jdt.8.3|Jdth.8:3]], [[Sir.18.16; 34.16; 43.22|Sir.18:16 34:16 43:22]] * ;]
1. burning heat (Ge, Isa (?), Jth, ll.with, [[Sir.18.16|Sir.18:16]]): [[Mat.20.12|Mat.20:12]], [[Luk.12.55|Luk.12:55]] ([[Jas.1.11|Jas.1:11]], AV).
2. a hot wind from the east (Heb. קָדִים, see LXX, ll.with), the modern sirocco (see CGT on [[Amo.4.9|Amo.4:9]]): [[Jas.1.11|Jas.1:11]] (RV, the scorching wind; cf. R, mg., the hot wind, Mt, Lk, ll.with).†
(AS)

G2715.def:
**κατ-εξουσιάζω **
**to exercise authority over**: with genitive of person(s), [[Mat.20.25|Mat.20:25]], [[Mrk.10.42|Mrk.10:42]].†
**SYN**: (κατακυριεύω) (see Swete, _Mk._, l.with)
(AS)

G2713.def:
**κατέναντι **
_adv._, [in LXX chiefly for נֶגֶד, פָּנִים, [[Gen.7.1|Gen.7:1]], etc. ;]
**over against, opposite, before**: ἡ, κ. κώμη, [[Luk.19.30|Luk.19:30]] as prep., with genitive, [[Mat.21.2; 27.24|Mat.21:2 27:24]] (ἀπ-, WH, mg.), [[Mrk.11.2; 12.41|Mrk.11:2 12:41]] (ἀπ-, WH, mg.) [[Mrk.13.3|Mrk.13:3]] metaphorically, before, before θεοῦ, [[Rom.4.17|Rom.4:17]], [[2Co.2.17; 12.19|2Co.2:17 12:19]].†
(AS)

G2795.def:
**κινέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX for נוּעַ hi., רָמַשׂ, etc. ;]
1. **to set in motion, move**: [[Mat.23.4|Mat.23:4]] τ. κεφαλήν ([[Psa.22.8|Psa.22:8]], al.), [[Mat.27.39|Mat.27:39]], [[Mrk.15.29|Mrk.15:29]]; pass. (cf. [[Gen.7.21|Gen.7:21]]), [[Act.17.28|Act.17:28]].
2. **to remove**: [[Rev.2.5; 6.14|Rev.2:5 6:14]].
3. **to excite, stir up**: [[Act.24.5|Act.24:5]] pass., [[Act.21.30|Act.21:30]] (cf. μετα-, συν-κινέω).†
(AS)

G2708.def:
**κατα-χέω **
[in LXX for יָצַק, נָטָה, עָטָה hi. ;]
**to pour down upon**: with genitive (cl.), [[Mrk.14.3|Mrk.14:3]] before ἐπί, with genitive, [[Mat.26.7|Mat.26:7]]†
(AS)

G2705.def:
**κατα-φιλέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for נָשַׁק ;]
**to kiss fervently, kiss affectionately**: [[Mat.26.49|Mat.26:49]], [[Mrk.14.45|Mrk.14:45]], [[Luk.7.38, 45; 15.20|Luk.7:38, 45 15:20]], [[Act.20.37|Act.20:37]].†
(AS)

G2763.def:
**κεραμεύς**, -εως, ὁ
(κεράννυμι), [in LXX for יָצַר, [[Psa.2.9|Psa.2:9]], [[Jer.18.2|Jer.18:2]], al. ;]
**a potter**: [[Rom.9.21|Rom.9:21]] ὁ ἀγρὸς τοῦ κ., [[Mat.27.7|Mat.27:7]], (LXX).†
(AS)

G2756.def:
**κενός**, -ή, -όν
[in LXX chiefly for רִיק and cognate forms ;]
empty ([[Gen.37.24|Gen.37:24]], [[Jdg.7.16|Jdg.7:16]]). Metaphorical,
(a) **empty, vain**: λόγοι, [[Eph.5.6|Eph.5:6]] ἀπάτη, [[Col.2.8|Col.2:8]] κήρυγμα, πίστις, [[1Co.15.14|1Co.15:14]]
(b) **vain, fruitless**: ἡ χάρις, [[1Co.15.10|1Co.15:10]] κόπος, [[1Co.15.50|1Co.15:50]] ἡ εἴσοδος, [[1Th.2.1|1Th.2:1]] κενά, [[Act.4.25|Act.4:25]] (LXX); εἰς κενόν, in vain, to no purpose (Diod., LXX; cl. διὰ κενῆς), [[2Co.6.1|2Co.6:1]], [[Gal.2.2|Gal.2:2]], [[Php.2.16|Php.2:16]], [[1Th.3.5|1Th.3:5]];
(with) **of persons, empty-handed**: [[Mrk.12.3|Mrk.12:3]], [[Luk.1.53; 20.10-11|Luk.1:53 20:10-11]]; vain, [[Jas.2.20|Jas.2:20]]†
_SYN._: μάταιος, of the aim or effect of an action, κ. of its quality (Lft. on Cl. Rom., 1Co., § 7; Tr., _Syn._, xlix) (AS)

G2775.def:
**κεφαλιόω** (Rec. -αιόω, [so in LXX: [[Sir.32.8|Sir.32:8]] *]), -ῶ
(κεφάλιον, dimin. of κεφαλή, in late writers)
1. (-αιόω) to sum up (Thuc., al.).
2. (In NT, only) to wound on the head: [[Mrk.12.4|Mrk.12:4]]†
(AS)

G2765.def:
**κεράμιον**, -ου, τό
(κέραμος), [in LXX: [[Jer.35.5|Jer.35:5]] (גְּבִיעַ), etc. ;]
**an earthen vessel, a jar or jug**: ὕδατος, [[Mrk.14.13|Mrk.14:13]], [[Luk.22.10|Luk.22:10]].†
(AS)

G2727.def:
**κατ-ηχέω**, -ῶ
1. to resound.
2. **to teach by word of mouth, instruct, inform **(see 131., Phil. Gosp., 20, 31): [[Gal.6.6|Gal.6:6]] with accusative of person(s), [[1Co.14.19|1Co.14:19]] pass. with accusative of thing(s), [[Luk.1.4|Luk.1:4]] (_ICC_, in l), [[Act.18.25; 21.24|Act.18:25 21:24]] (cf. Lk, l.with), [[Gal.6.6|Gal.6:6]] before κ, with genitive of thing(s), [[Rom.2.18|Rom.2:18]] περί, with genitive of person(s), [[Act.21.21|Act.21:21]]†
(AS)

G2768.def:
**κέρας**, -ατος
(pl. not irreg. as in Attic), τό, [in LXX chiefly for קָרַן ;]
**a horn**: [[Rev.5.6; 12.3; 13.1, 11; 17.3, 7; 17.12, 16|Rev.5:6 12:3 13:1, 11 17:3, 7 17:12, 16]]; of the projections at the corners of the altar ([[Exo.29.12|Exo.29:12]], al.): [[Rev.9.13|Rev.9:13]]. Metaphorical, as symbol of strength, κ. σωτηρίας (cf. [[Psa.18.3|Psa.18:3]], al.): [[Luk.1.69|Luk.1:69]].†
(AS)

G2720.def:
**κατ-ευθύνω **
[in LXX for כּוּן ni., hi., etc. ;]
**to make or keep straight, direct, guide**: metaphorically, τ. ὁδόν, [[1Th.3.11|1Th.3:11]] τ. πόδας εἰς ὁδὸν εἰρήνης, [[Luk.1.79|Luk.1:79]] τ. καρδίας εἰς τ. ἀγάπην, [[2Th.3.5|2Th.3:5]]†
(AS)

G2718.def:
**κατ-έρχομαι **
[in LXX: [[Tob.1.22|Tob.1:22]], א [[Tob.2.1|Tob.2:1]], [[Est.3.13|Est.3:13]], [[Wis.11.22|Wis.11:22]], [[2Ma.11.29|2Ma.11:29]] * ;]
**to come down, go down**: before εἰς, [[Luk.4.31|Luk.4:31]], [[Act.8.5; 13.4; 15.30; 19.1|Act.8:5 13:4 15:30 19:1]], Τ; ἀπό, [[Luk.9.37|Luk.9:37]], [[Act.15.1; 18.5; 21.10|Act.15:1 18:5 21:10]]; ἀπό and εἰς, [[Act.11.27; 12.10|Act.11:27 12:10]]; of coming to port by ship, [[Act.18.22; 21.3; 27.5|Act.18:22 21:3 27:5]]; before πρός, with accusative of person(s), [[Act.9.32|Act.9:32]] metaphorically, of gifts from God, [[Jas.3.15|Jas.3:15]]†
(AS)

G2722.def:
**κατ-έχω **
[in LXX for אָחַז, חָזַק hi., etc. ;]
1. perfective of ἔχω (M, _Pr._, 116; M, _Th._, 155),
(a) **to possess, hold fast**: [[Luk.8.15|Luk.8:15]], [[Jhn.5.4|Jhn.5:4]], [[Rom.1.18|Rom.1:18]] (Lft., _Notes_, 251), [[1Co.7.30; 11.2|1Co.7:30 11:2]], [[2Co.6.10|2Co.6:10]], [[1Th.5.21|1Th.5:21]], [[Heb.3.6, 14; 10.23|Heb.3:6, 14 10:23]];
(b) **to lay hold of, get possession of**: [[Luk.14.9|Luk.14:9]]
2. **to hold back, detain, restrain **(M, _Th._, 156 f.): with accusative before τοῦ μή with inf., [[Luk.4.42|Luk.4:42]] before πρός, with accusative, Phm 13; absol., τὸ κατέχον (ὁ κ.), [[2Th.2.6-7|2Th.2:6-7]]
3. Intrans., **as nautical term, to put in, make for **(LS, see word): [[Act.27.40|Act.27:40]]†
(AS)

G2766.def:
**κεραμος**, -ου, ὁ
(κεράννυμι), [in LXX: [[2Sa.17.28|2Ki.17:28]] (יָצַר כְּלִי)* ;]
1. potter's clay.
2. an earthen vessel.
3. **a tile**: [[Luk.5.19|Luk.5:19]]†
(AS)

G2793.def:
**κινδυνεύω**
(κίνδυνος), [in LXX for יָקֹשׁ ni., etc. ;]
1. to be daring, to venture.
2. **to be in danger**: [[Luk.8.23|Luk.8:23]], [[Act.19.27, 40|Act.19:27, 40]], [[1Co.15.30|1Co.15:30]].†
(AS)

G2769.def:
**κεράτιον**, -ου, τό
(dimin. of κέρας),
1. a little horn (Arist.).
2. In pl. (the fruit of the κερατέα), **carob-pods**: [[Luk.15.16|Luk.15:16]]†
(AS)

G2773.def:
**κερματιατής**, -οῦ, ὁ
(κερματίζω, to cut small, coin into small money),
**a money changer**: [[Jhn.2.14|Jhn.2:14]]†
(AS)

G2772.def:
**κέρμα**, -τος, τό
(κείρω),
1. **a slice, hence, **
2. **a small coin**: pl., [[Jhn.2.15|Jhn.2:15]]†
(AS)

G2750.def:
**κειρία**, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX: [[Pro.7.16|Pro.7:16]] (מַרְבַד)* ;]
**a vernacular word, **
1 1, a bed-cord (Aristoph., AV., 816; Pr, l.with).
2. In pl., **swathings **(cf. Field, _Notes_, 96 f.): [[Jhn.11.44|Jhn.11:44]]†
(AS)

G2748.def:
**κέδρος**, -ου, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for אֶרֶז, [[Num.24.6|Num.24:6]], al.; χειμάρρους τῶν Κέδρων, [[2Ki.15.23|2Ki.15:23]], [[1Ki.15.13|3Ki.15:13]] (קִדְרוֹן) ;]
**a cedar**: χείμαρρος τῶν Κ. (as in 2Sam, 1Ki, ll. with), [[Jhn.18.1|Jhn.18:1]] (Rec. Tr., WH, R, mg.; τοῦ Κέδρου, T, WH, mg., see: Κεδρών, and cf. Westc., in l; WH, _App._, 89 f.; Abbott, _JG_, 513 ff).†
Κεδρών
(see: κέδρος), ὁ,
indecl.
(in FlJ, genitive -ῶνος; _Heb._ קִדְרוֹן), [in LXX: [[2Ki.15.23|2Ki.15:23]], [[2Ki.23.6|4Ki.23:6]], al. ;]
**Cedron **(OT, Kidron): χείμαρρος τοῦ Κ., [[Jhn.18.1|Jhn.18:1]] (L, Tr., mg., R, txt.; cf. Bl., 10, 5; Lft., _Essays_, 172 ff).†
(AS)

G2724.def:
**κατηγορία**, -ας, ἡ
(κατήγορος),
**an accusation, charge**: with genitive of person(s), [[Jhn.18.29|Jhn.18:29]] before κατά, with id., [[1Ti.5.19|1Ti.5:19]] with genitive of thing(s), [[Tit.1.6|Tit.1:6]]†
(AS)

G2751.def:
**κείρω **
[in LXX chiefly for גָּזַז, [[Isa.53.7|Isa.53:7]], al. ;]
**to cut short the hair, shear**: a sheep, [[Act.8.32|Act.8:32]] (Isa, l.with). Mid., **to have one's hair cut off, be shorn**: absol., [[1Co.11.6|1Co.11:6]] τ-. κεφαλήν, [[Act.18.18|Act.18:18]]†
(AS)

G2707.def:
**κατα-φρονητής**, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX for בָּגַד, בֹּגְדוֹת, [[Hab.1.5; 2.5|Hab.1:5 2:5]], [[Zep.3.4|Zep.3:4]] * ;]
**a despiser**: [[Act.13.41|Act.13:41]]†
(AS)

G2703.def:
**κατα-φεύγω **
[in LXX for נוּס, etc. ;]
**to flee for refuge**: before εἰς, [[Act.14.6|Act.14:6]] metaphorically, with inf., [[Heb.6.18|Heb.6:18]]†
(AS)

G2733.def:
**κατ-οικία**, -ας, ἡ
(κατοικέω), [in LXX chiefly for מוֹשָׁב, [[Exo.35.3|Exo.35:3]], al. ;]
1. **a dwelling**: [[Act.17.26|Act.17:26]]
2. a settlement (Polyb.).†
(AS)

G2747.def:
**Κενχρεαί** (Rec. Κεχγ-; ν. WH, _App._, 150), -ῶν, αἱ,
**Cenchreæ, a port of Corinth**: [[Act.18.18|Act.18:18]], [[Rom.16.1|Rom.16:1]].†
(AS)

G2702.def:
**κατα-φέρω **
[in LXX for יָרַד hi., etc. ;]
**to bring down**: αἰτιώματα, [[Act.25.7|Act.25:7]] ψῆφον, to cast a ballot, [[Act.26.10|Act.26:10]] pass., **to be borne down**: ὕπνῳ, ἀπὸ τ. ὕ., [[Act.20.9|Act.20:9]]†
(AS)

G2701.def:
**κατα-τρέχω **
[in LXX: [[Lev.26.37|Lev.26:37]], [[Jdg.1.6|Jdg.1:6]] (רָדַף), al. ;]
**to run down**: before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), [[Act.21.32|Act.21:32]]†
(AS)

G2774.def:
**κεφάλαιος**, -α, -ον
(κεφαλή), [in LXX (-αιον, τό) for רֹאשׁ, Num_4:2, al. ;]
**of the head**; metaphorically, principal, chief; mostly as subst., κεφάλαιον, τό;
1. **the chief point**: [[Heb.8.1|Heb.8:1]]
2. **the sum total, amount**: [[Act.22.28|Act.22:28]] (other meaning, LS, see word).†
(AS)

G2716.def:
**κατ-εργάζομαι**
(emphatic form of ἐργάζομαι), [in LXX for פָּעַל, etc. (9 exx., each for a different _Heb._ word) ;]
**to effect by labour, achieve, work out, bring about**: with accusative, [[Rom.4.15; 5.3; 7.8, 15-20|Rom.4:15 5:3 7:8, 15-20]], [[2Co.7.10|2Co.7:10]], [[Eph.6.13|Eph.6:13]], [[Jas.1.3|Jas.1:3]]; pass., [[2Co.12.12|2Co.12:12]] with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), [[Rom.7.13|Rom.7:13]], [[2Co.4.17; 7.11; 9.11|2Co.4:17 7:11 9:11]]; id. before διά, with genitive of person(s), [[Rom.15.18|Rom.15:18]] τ. σωτηρίαν, [[Php.2.12|Php.2:12]] with accusative of person(s) before εἰς, [[2Co.5.5|2Co.5:5]] (RV, wrought); of evil deeds, [[Rom.1.27; 2.9|Rom.1:27 2:9]], [[1Co.5.3|1Co.5:3]], [[1Pe.4.3|1Pe.4:3]].†
(AS)

G2744.def:
**καυχάομαι**, -ῶμαι
[in LXX for הָלַל hith., etc. ;]
to boast or glory (in LXX, of joyous exultation, and so in the NT quotations, infr.; cf. _DB_, ii, 790b; Hort on [[Jas.1.9|Jas.1:9]]): absol., [[1Co.1.31|1Co.1:31]] (LXX) [[1Co.4.7; 13.3|1Co.4:7 13:3]], [[2Co.10.13; 10.17|2Co.10:13 10:17]]" (LXX) [[2Co.11.16; 11.18; 12.1; 12.6|2Co.11:16 11:18 12:1 12:6]], [[Eph.2.9|Eph.2:9]], [[Jas.4.16|Jas.4:16]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[2Co.9.2; 11.30|2Co.9:2 11:30]]; before ἐν (LXX), [[Rom.2.23; 5.3|Rom.2:23 5:3]], [[1Co.3.21|1Co.3:21]], [[2Co.5.12; 10.15; 11.12; 12.5; 12.9|2Co.5:12 10:15 11:12 12:5 12:9]], [[Gal.6.13-14|Gal.6:13-14]] [[Jas.1.9|Jas.1:9]]; ἐν (τ.) θεῷ, [[Rom.2.17; 5.11|Rom.2:17 5:11]]; ἐν κυρίῳ, [[1Co.1.31|1Co.1:31]] (LXX) [[2Co.10.17|2Co.10:17]] (LXX); ἐν Χ. Ἰησοῦ, [[Php.3.3|Php.3:3]] before ἐπί with dative, [[Rom.5.2|Rom.5:2]] περί, with genitive, [[2Co.10.8|2Co.10:8]] εἰς, [[2Co.10.16|2Co.10:16]] ὑπέρ, with genitive of person(s), [[2Co.7.14; 12.5|2Co.7:14 12:5]]; ἐνώπιον τ. θεοῦ, [[1Co.1.29|1Co.1:29]] (cf. ἐν, κατα-καυχάομαι).†
(AS)

G2746.def:
**καύχησις**, -εως, ἡ
(καυχάομαι), [in LXX for תִּפְאָרָה ([[1Ch.29.13|1Ch.29:13]], [[Ezk.16.12|Eze.16:12]], al) ;]
**a boasting, glorying**: [[Rom.3.27|Rom.3:27]], [[2Co.11.10; 11.17|2Co.11:10 11:17]], [[Jas.4.16|Jas.4:16]]; before ὑπέρ, [[2Co.7.4; 8.24|2Co.7:4 8:24]]; ἐτί, with genitive, [[2Co.7.14|2Co.7:14]] ἔχω τὴν κ. ἐν Χρ. Ἰησ., [[Rom.15.17|Rom.15:17]] στέφανος καυχήσεως (Ez. l.with, al.), [[1Th.2.19|1Th.2:19]] of the cause of glorying, a boast ( = καύχημα), [[2Co.1.12|2Co.1:12]]†
(AS)

G2745.def:
**καύχημα**, -τος, τό
(καυχάομαι), [in LXX chiefly for תְּהִלָּה, תִּפְאָרָה ;]
1. **a boast **(Pind.): [[2Co.5.12; 9.3|2Co.5:12 9:3]] (Thayer, see word; e. contra, 2, Ellic., Lft., on [[Gal.6.4|Gal.6:4]] Lft., _Notes_, 204, 277).
2. **ground or matter of glorying**: [[Rom.4.2|Rom.4:2]], [[1Co.5.6; 9.15-16|1Co.5:6 9:15-16]], [[2Co.1.14|2Co.1:14]], [[Gal.6.4|Gal.6:4]], [[Php.1.26; 2.16|Php.1:26 2:16]], [[Heb.3.6|Heb.3:6]] (cf. καύχησις).†
(AS)

G2758.def:
**κενόω**, -ῶ
(κενός, which see), [in LXX: [[Jer.14.2; 15.9|Jer.14:2 15:9]] (עָמָל pu.)* ;]
to empty. Metaphorical, to empty, make empty, vain or of no effect: καύχημα, [[1Co.9.15|1Co.9:15]] ἑαυτόν, of Christ, [[Php.2.7|Php.2:7]] (v Lft.; _ICC_, in 1, and esp. Gifford, Incarn., 54 ff.); pass., πίστις, [[Rom.4.14|Rom.4:14]] ὁ σταυρός, [[1Co.1.17|1Co.1:17]] καύχημα, [[2Co.9.3|2Co.9:3]]†
(AS)

G2710.def:
**κατα-χράομαι**, -ῶμαι
[in LXX: Ep. Je.28, [[3Ma.4.5|3Ma.4:5]] [[3Mac.5.22|3Mac 5:22]] * ;]
**to make full use of, use to the uttermost, use up**: [[1Co.7.31|1Co.7:31]] with dative, [[1Co.9.18|1Co.9:18]] (for other senses, see LS, see word)..†
(AS)

G2788.def:
**κιθάρα**, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for כִּנּוֹר, frequently in [[Psa.33.2|Psa.33:2]], al.); and in ([[Dan.3.5|Dan.3:5]], al.) for קִיתָרֹס, itself a transliteration of κίθαρις, the Homeric form of κ. (cf. CB, Dn., lviii) ;]
**a lyre, harp**: [[1Co.14.7|1Co.14:7]], [[Rev.5.8; 14.2; 15.2|Rev.5:8 14:2 15:2]].†
(AS)

G2789.def:
**κιθαρίζω **
[in LXX: [[Isa.23.16|Isa.23:16]] (נָגַן pi.)* ;]
**to play upon the lyre or harp**: [[1Co.14.7|1Co.14:7]], [[Rev.14.2|Rev.14:2]].†
(AS)

G2734.def:
**κατοπτρίζω**
(κάτοπτρον, a mirror),
to show as in a mirror. Mid., to see oneself mirrored (see MM, _Exp._, xv); with accusative of thing(s) (R, txt., but see mg.), **to reflect as a mirror**: [[2Co.3.18|2Co.3:18]] (cf. Abbott, _Essays_, 94).†
(AS)

G2714.def:
**κατενώπιον **
_adv._ (= Hom., κατένωπα), [in LXX: [[Psa.44.15|Psa.44:15]], al. ;]
**over against, before**: with genitive, τ. δόξης, [[Jude.24|Ju 24]]; metaphorically (cf. κατέναντι, and see Lft., Col., l.with), τ. θεοῦ, [[Eph.1.4|Eph.1:4]], [[Col.1.22|Col.1:22]].†
(AS)

G2732.def:
**κατ-οικητήριον**, -ου, τό
(κατοικέω), [in LXX for מוֹשָׁב, מָעוֹן, etc. ;]
**a habitation, dwelling-place**: [[Eph.2.22|Eph.2:22]], [[Rev.18.2|Rev.18:2]].†
(AS)

G2737.def:
**κατώτερος**, -έρα, -ερον
(κάτω), [in LXX for תַּחְתּוֹן, תַּחְתִּי ;]
**lower**; τὰ. κ. τῆς γῆς (see AR, _Eph._, l.with; for rendering this lower earth, see _ICC_, Eph, l.with), the lower parts of the earth (cf. [[Psa.139.15|Psa.139:15]] cf. also M_Gr._, ἡ κάτου γῆ, the underworld, Thumb, MGV, 334): [[Eph.4.9|Eph.4:9]]†
(AS)

G2754.def:
**κενοδοξία**, -ας, ἡ
(κενόδοξος), [in LXX: [[Wis.14.14|Wis.14:14]], [[2Ma.2.15|2Ma.2:15]] [[2Mac.8.10|2Mac 8:10]] * ;]
1. foolish fancy, vain opinion, error (LXX, ll. with).
2. **vain­glory, groundless conceit**: [[Php.2.3|Php.2:3]]†
(AS)

G2709.def:
**κατα-χθόνιος**, -ον
(χθών, the earth),
**subterranean, under the earth **(in cl., of the infernal gods): of the departed in Hades, opposite to ἐπουράνιος, ἐπίγειος, [[Php.2.10|Php.2:10]]†
(AS)

G2752.def:
**κέλευσμα**, -τος, τό
(κελεύω), [in LXX: [[Pro.30.27|Pro.30:27]] * ;]
**a call, summons, shout of command**: [[1Th.4.16|1Th.4:16]] (see M, _Th._, in l).†
(AS)

G2743.def:
**καυστηριάζω** (Rec. καυτηρ-, and so usually in Gk. writers, see Soph., _Lex._, see word)
**to mark by branding, brand **(AV, scar, but see CGT, in l): metaphorically, pass. pf. ptcp., [[1Ti.4.2|1Ti.4:2]] (cf. καυτήριον, [[4Ma.15.22|4Ma.15:22]] *).†
(AS)

G2757.def:
**κενοφωνία**, -ας, ἡ
(κενός, φωνέω), [cf. κενολογέω (צָפַף), [[Isa.8.19|Isa.8:19]] * ;]
**empty talk, babbling**: pl., [[1Ti.6.20|1Ti.6:20]], [[2Ti.2.16|2Ti.2:16]].†
(AS)

G2704.def:
**κατα-φθείρω **
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁחַת hi., [[Gen.6.12|Gen.6:12]], al. ;]
1 1 to destroy entirely.
2. In moral sense (as LXX), **to deprave, corrupt**: pass. pf. ptcp., before τ. νο ν, [[2Ti.3.8|2Ti.3:8]]†
(AS)

G2740.def:
**καῦσις**, -εως, ἡ
(καίω), [in LXX for בָּעַר pi., etc. ;]
**burning**: [[Heb.6.8|Heb.6:8]]†
(AS)

G2777.def:
**κεφαλίς**, -ίδος, ἡ
(dimin. of κεφαλή), [in LXX for מְגִלָּה, וָו, etc. ;]
1. a little head.
2. an extremity, capital (of a column).
3. (As in [[Exo.2.9|Exo.2:9]], [[Psa.40.8|Psa.40:8]], [[Est.6.2|Est.6:2]]) a roll: κ. βιβλίου, [[Heb.10.7|Heb.10:7]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G2728.def:
**κατ-ιόω**, -ῶ
(intensive of ἰόω; ἰός) [in LXX: [[Sir.12.11|Sir.12:11]] * ;]
**to rust over**; pass., **become rusted over**: [[Jas.5.3|Jas.5:3]]†
(AS)

G2741.def:
**καυσόω**, -ῶ
(καῦσος, burning heat, fever),
only in pass.,
1. to burn with fever (Galen., al.).
2. **In NT, to burn with great heat**: [[2Pe.3.10; 3.12|2Pe.3:10 3:12]] (V. Mayor, in l).†
(AS)

G2764.def:
**κεραμικός**, -ή, -όν
(κέραμος), [in LXX: Dan LXX 2:41 (פֶּחָר)* ;]
1. (cl.) of a potter (e.g. γῆ).
2. In LXX and NT, = cl., κεραμεοῦς (Plut., κεράμειος, Polyb., -μαῖος, etc), **earthen**: [[Rev.2.27|Rev.2:27]]†
(AS)

G2738.def:
**καῦμα**, -τος, τό
(καίω), [in LXX for חֹם, חֹרֶב, etc. ;]
**heat**: [[Rev.7.16; 16.9|Rev.7:16 16:9]].†
(AS)

G2790.def:
**κιθαρ-ωδός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(κιθάρα, ἀοιδός, a singer)
**one who plays and sings to the lyre, a harper**: [[Rev.14.2; 18.22|Rev.14:2 18:22]].†
(AS)

G2767.def:
**κεράννυμι **
[in LXX for מָסַךְ, [[Isa.5.22|Isa.5:22]], al. ;]
**to mix, mingle, chiefly of the diluting of wine**: [[Rev.18.6|Rev.18:6]] by oxymoron, κεκεράσμενος ἄκρατος, [[Rev.14.10|Rev.14:10]]†
_SYN._: μίγνυμι. κ. implies "a mixing of two things, so that they are blended and forma compound, as in wine and water, whereas μ. implies a mixing without such composition, as in two sorts of grain" (LS, see word κρᾶσις) (AS)

G2792.def:
**κιννάμωμον**(Rec. κινάμ-), -υο, τό
(from the Phænician, see LS, see word, and cf. _Heb._ קִנָּמוֹן)
**cinnamon**: [[Rev.18.13|Rev.18:13]]†
(AS)
